content: Hi! I'm staying in Utrecht for 4 months, anybody here?
I'll be arriving in Utrecht in 6 months...
There's a Lean crowd in Amsterdam and in Leiden. But I'm not aware of much activity in Utrecht (yet).

I'm currently at the VU Amsterdam but I studied in Utrecht and still live close by. It might be nice to meet up sometime soon! The CS department has some people interested in formal verification, for example Wouter Swierstra was a supervisor for my Master's thesis.
I've touched down in NL. I'll be starting at the UU math dept in September.

Hello, I would like to invite you to our first informal Loki meetup, happening every Tuesday at 17:30 in the library of the maths department starting next week. There will be room for working on projects, discussing about formalization and learning more Lean. Anyone interested is welcome to join, no pre-requisites are needed.
Note: The day of the week of Loki has moved to Thursday. The message above is updated accordingly.

Hi Christian! Is there a session today? I am now at the department and want to check it out
Yes, there is! And you figured that out, because you showed up :)

Next thursday (May 14) is Hemelvaart (ascension day) and the university will be closed. For this reason, next week's Loki will happen on Wednesday, May 13. After that, we return to the usual schedule.
